quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Stop only to let other traffic pass.
Other vehicles will enter the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all traffic and pedestrians cross, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about dangerous road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: When stopping at an intersection, use your mirrors to:

options.text: Check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
Look for dark clouds that may mean bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors to see vehicles coming behind you. Make sure other drivers see you and react to your stop.

questions.question: To avoid a crash, you should:

options.text: Only watch your own riding, not what is around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright or reflective clothing.
questions.explanation: Bright or reflective clothing makes you easier to see and helps prevent crashes. Also watch the drivers around you and prepare for their movements.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way.
Move to a position in your lane where other drivers can see you better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to a position in your lane where other drivers can see you better.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, change your lane position to be more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: Keeping space between you and other vehicles helps because:

options.text: You can draft off other vehicles better.
You have more time to react if other drivers move suddenly.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react if other drivers move suddenly.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle at all times. This gives you time to react to dangers and room to move safely.

questions.question: To be more visible to other road users, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Wear brightly-colored clothing.
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors like orange, red, yellow, or green when riding. Reflective material also helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: To improve your chances of surviving a crash, wear:
questions.correctAnswerText: A DOT-compliant helmet.
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets DOT and state standards gives the best head and neck protection. A good helmet, worn properly, is the best way to survive a crash.

questions.question: When the lights on a railroad crossing sign are flashing, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Turn around and find another route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing lights at a railroad crossing, stop completely. Wait until the train passes and the lights stop flashing before going. Never try to cross before a train.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.correctAnswerText: Bright clothing.
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors to be seen, even during the day. Reflective material also helps other drivers notice you.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of head or neck injury?
questions.correctAnswerText: By wearing a helmet.
questions.explanation: Head and neck injuries are a risk when riding a motorcycle, no matter your speed. Wearing a good helmet that fits properly greatly reduces this risk.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcyclists?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots.
questions.explanation: Leather boots provide the best foot protection. Boots should be high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: When stopping with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Ride a little faster than you normally would.
Start slowing earlier than you normally would.
Merge into smaller gaps of traffic than you normally would.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing earlier than you normally would.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight to your motorcycle. This extra weight makes the motorcycle slower to speed up, slow down, and turn. Start slowing down earlier and look for larger gaps in traffic when you have a passenger.

questions.question: What danger does wind noise pose?

options.text: It is easy to get used to.
It may cause permanent hearing damage.

questions.correctAnswerText: It may cause permanent hearing damage.
questions.explanation: Long-term exposure to wind noise can permanently damage your hearing. Wear ear plugs or hearing protection when riding.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden movements when possible.
questions.explanation: On a slippery surface, sudden changes in speed or direction can cause a skid. Accelerate, shift gears, turn, and brake smoothly.

questions.question: How can you reduce fatigue on a long trip?
questions.correctAnswerText: Limit your riding per day.
questions.explanation: Take frequent breaks to rest on long trips, even if you do not feel tired. Most experienced riders do not ride more than six hours per day. Wind, cold, and rain make you tire faster, so dress to protect yourself from the elements.

questions.question: How should a motorcyclist stop quickly?

options.text: Apply both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Apply both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply both brakes at the same time. Look ahead to avoid needing emergency stops.

questions.question: How should you approach a blind intersection?

options.text: Move to the part of the lane where other drivers can see you most easily.
Move to the part of the lane closest to the traffic control device.
Move to the outside edge of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the part of the lane where other drivers can see you most easily.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, position yourself so other drivers can see you as soon as possible.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.correctAnswerText: Wait.
questions.explanation: The only way to sober up is to give your body time to process the alcohol. Nothing can speed up this process.

questions.question: What should you check before every ride?

options.text: Make sure your bike's brake lights work properly.
Make sure the paint on the bike is not peeling.
Make sure your bike is completely clean.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your bike's brake lights work properly.
questions.explanation: Do a safety check before every ride. Test each brake to make sure the brake lights come on.

questions.question: After riding over an object on the road, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding because the danger is over.
Pull to the side of the road and check your tires and rims for damage.
Stop and remove the object from the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and check your tires and rims for damage.
questions.explanation: After riding over an object, pull off the road and check your tires and rims for damage before riding further. Also check that nothing is caught in the drive chain or belt.

questions.question: What is true about footrests?

options.text: The driver and passenger can share them.
They are required for both the driver and passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are required for both the driver and passenger.
questions.explanation: Keep your feet firmly on the footrests for balance. Your motorcycle must have footrests for the passenger. Good footing helps keep your passenger from falling off and pulling you off as well.

questions.question: What does a solid white line on the side of the road mean?

options.text: It marks the right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: It marks the right edge of a traffic lane.
questions.explanation: A solid white line on the side of the road shows where the right edge of a traffic lane is.

questions.question: What can remove alcohol from your body?
questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body. Your body needs time to process and remove the alcohol. Nothing else can speed up this process.

questions.question: How should you handle a tailgater?
questions.correctAnswerText: Let them pass you.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to let them pass. Speeding up may cause them to tailgate you at an even higher speed, which is more dangerous.
